master_objective: Build a governed, portable agent-development ecosystem where Custom GPT/system prompts can be created, enhanced, epistemically audited, deployed, observed, performance-audited and improved without losing human/main-host authority.
direction_notes: Prompt Creator and Prompt Enhancer should share one specification-engineering core where behavior overlaps, with distinct create/enhance modes rather than duplicated logic.
Reasoning Auditor validates visible rationale/evidence and recursive iteration quality; it is advisory and must not request or store private chain-of-thought.
Future system reasoning records should be concise auditable decision records (claims/evidence/assumptions/alternatives/decisions/unknowns/verification), not hidden reasoning transcripts.
Use real session evidence and Profile Performance Auditor before permanently promoting speculative governance machinery.

Custom Prompt is the selectable prompt-construction profile. Deep Research/search/web/files/connectors are capabilities/plugins selected separately by the user/host, not profiles and not automatic pipeline stages.

parts.title: Validate Reasoning Auditor on Real Recursive Prompt Work

parts.objective: Use actual Prompt Enhancer iteration rationale and prompt deltas to test Reasoning Auditor usefulness, false-positive discipline, metric-drift detection and recursive-degradation detection before deeper runtime promotion.
acceptance_criteria: Audit receives visible rationale/deltas, not hidden reasoning.
Auditor separates supported flaws from unverifiable claims.
Main host, not auditor, decides whether edits are accepted.

Five explicitly synthetic diagnostic controls reviewed; no independent benchmark or accuracy-rate claim.
Main host accepted bounded validation completion and retained candidate without deployment; Part 3 not promoted.
next_actions: Keep the standalone candidate undeployed pending a separate deployment decision.
